decisions.reason: Its prominent home-page placement and the firm's public commitment to the accelerator program create escalation pressure to persist despite its distance from the core machinery business.

The dedicated product page reflects visible R&D commitment, but the binder is less central and less prominently featured than the home-page products, so escalation is moderate but still favours keeping.

As a home-page product close to the established offer and central to the announced decentralized waste-treatment direction, it carries strong public and resource commitment, making dropping unlikely under escalation of commitment.
